It details the logic of counting intersections (back faces) to determine inside/outside status ('If c > 0.0f (back face), decrement counter... If counter == 0, a segment is closed'). This confirms the use of ray-mesh intersection to compute solid intervals per pixel, supporting the claim that this is the explicit mechanism used.
